title: Uniform marked-polygon estimates and sharp finite bridge moments
main_claim: For critical honeycomb walks (kappa=1/(2cos(pi/8))), the strip bridge mass is B_h ≍ h^{-1/4}. The first length moment of bridges is at most C h^{13/12}, and bridges of length at least c h^{4/3} carry mass at least c h^{-1/4}. The proof goes through a uniform two-axial-mark polygon bound C N^{-4/3}(N/d)^{15/8} on the cylinder R^2/(kP Z) when d is even, and a nesting estimate Z ≍ R^{1/12}.

issues.location: sections/magnetic.tex, Lemma lem:u-homogeneous-operator (cyclic-trace identification and one-line comparison)
issues.description: The strict spectral bound spr(T_±) < exp(S_0/2) carries the whole unequal-interval estimate: the tails contribute (R-2u_0)/2. The bound rests on three steps. (1) The cyclic traces of the Fock/cell operator are identified with a homogeneous gas, obtained as a limit M_A=0, M_B→∞ of the two-line residue transform. (2) The same residue sum is compared with a one-line representation whose particle pressure is at most 1/(πL). (3) The one-line determinant rate is 1/12. Each step is stated in compressed form, and I could not reconstruct the justification line by line. The numerical margin 8/π^2 - 5/12 ≈ 0.394 < 1/2 checks. I found no specific failing step, so this is only a verifiability note.
issues.evidence: 'Comparing both limiting expressions, the desired homogeneous log trace per unit length is at most 1/(πL)+1/12-1/2+o(1)<1/2.'

issues.location: sections/gas.tex / periodic-polynomial.tex (current expansion, Prop. gas-upper, exponent 3/8+2r^2/(3π^2))
issues.description: The upper bound log|P_m(e^r)| ≤ Im^2 + (3/8 + 2r^2/(3π^2)) log m + o(log m) feeds both saturation and the marked estimate, and these sections were only spot-checked. The scalar bookkeeping is consistent: T r^2/(4h_*) with T=(2/a_0)log m gives 2r^2/(3π^2), and πT/(16L) gives 3/8. The contour and zero-mode deformations were not re-derived.
